# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before any change and follow it: it is the rulebook for every contributor,
human or agent. Its section 6 lists the mistakes agents made in this repository and the rule for each. Work only inside
the paths your task owns, write tests first, and run the gate commands of `docs/BUILD-CHARTER.md` section 8 before you
call anything done.
